experiment: FinanceBench self-revision without explicit validator feedback
status: fixed before any new paid completion
sample: Exact 50 previously inspected FinanceBench evaluation questions used in v4; post-hoc ablation, not a fresh holdout
model: Same pinned DeepSeek model/provider, temperature zero, seed 18, 4096 output cap and typed contract as v4
shared_initial: Reuse exact first draft and initial retrieved evidence; verify original request and parsed-attempt hashes; no first-draft billing again
new_calls: Exactly two new answer completions per question, 100 total, in passes two and three
revision_context: Previous model's declared typed answer or raw malformed reply plus the same generic reconsideration instruction and pass number; no validator verdict, source audit, acceptance, parser issues, executed result, reference answer or gold evidence
retrieval: Same initial top-10 known-report evidence in all passes; no retrieval call, reformulation or evidence augmentation
execution: Same bounded arithmetic/output parsing as v4 in every arm; diagnostics are not supplied to the revision model
stopping_and_selection: No early stopping; always three answer passes even if an earlier draft is usable; final third draft is scored, including malformed/abstained drafts; no best-of-three selection
comparators: v4 single-shot exact shared first draft
primary_diagnostic: Unchanged v4 normalized literal reference agreement across all 50; scalar numerical F1 on 16 whole-numeric-reference items is secondary; neither is human factual accuracy
uncertainty: Paired per-question transitions and 2000 filing-cluster bootstrap draws, seed 18, reported for unguided minus each comparator
budget_comparability: Shared maximum of three answer attempts, not matched total LLM calls, tokens or stopping rule. Validated fixed retrieval adds checking calls and adaptive stopping; full arm also changes retrieval. Do not attribute differences solely to validation
human_evaluation: Deferred as requested; all exports remain unreviewed
scope: Workshop RAG component ablation only; no CL controlled-history, dependency or repair study imported
spending: User explicitly lifted former $20 overall ceiling. This finite 100-new-request experiment uses existing key/server limits, preserves receipts and reports actual cost; no automatic ambiguous paid retry
reporting: Report all outcomes regardless of score and preserve all earlier experiments unchanged; no model, prompt, scorer or sample tuning after assessment
